primary_matrix.source: Brenders and Pratt(2007), Efficient waveform tomography for lithospheric imaging
primary_matrix.verified_location: Efficient Waveform Tomography: Frequency selection strategy, eqs1-5; source/receiver-subsampling and minimum-frequency experiments; publisher-indexed full sections inspected, direct open unavailable.
primary_matrix.established_control: Low-to-high frequency inversion and coverage-aware frequency selection, evaluated with acquisition sampling and starting-model assumptions.
primary_matrix.tradeoff: Requires usable low frequencies and adequate illumination; four frequencies are not interchangeable merely because their count matches. Extra/changed data alter the task and costs. Geometry-dependent results do not guarantee recovery for this tiny Dirichlet survey. A certificate cannot create missing wavenumber coverage.

primary_matrix.verified_location: The Gauss-Newton method, eq35; damped/Levenberg-Marquardt eq36; resolution eqs37-38; AppendixA Alternative Parametrization. Original publisher-indexed sections inspected; direct page open failed.
primary_matrix.established_control: Curvature-scaled updates, damping for singular/ill-conditioned Hessians and alternative inversion bases.
primary_matrix.tradeoff: Linearization, derivative/Hessian work, rank deficiency and damping remain material. Their stationarity/update machinery is not a truth-recovery guarantee. AppendixA concerns basis parameters; the present nonlinear m-to-velocity coordinate effect is a separate chain-rule inference, not a claimed reproduction. Changing gradient coordinates changes the update metric, whereas relabeling reported error does not.

primary_matrix.source: Esser etal(2018), Total Variation Regularization Strategies in Full-Waveform Inversion
primary_matrix.verified_location: Author preprint sectionsII-III, constrained updates eqs6,13; IV Numerical Experiments; continuation discussion onPDFpage36. Journal DOI/metadata independently verified; final publisherPDF inaccessible.
primary_matrix.established_control: Box plus TV/asymmetric-TV constraints and scaled constrained subproblems in conventional/extended FWI.
primary_matrix.tradeoff: Adds explicit structural information and bias; box-feasibility alone is insufficient. Tight TV can erase real structure, while directional priors can be wrong. The inspected preprint explicitly discusses choosing constraint radii proportional to true-model values. That oracle choice must not be imported here: usable prior strength needs justification independent of hidden truth. Added constrained-solver work remains paid.

Favorable examples are not a universal local-minimum or identifiability guarantee.
